Hey, everyone
Can you guys help me a QTE Event in RPG Maker MV where you bars like this, with 3 colors of varying lengths my game's resolution is 1440 x 810, and the pictures' origin is center, coordinates x640 y360... I will send you a link on how to event a QTE event and I want us to use that same logic but expand it to my version, in my version, I want to make it so that it has 3 options. 1 is the red, 2 is yellow and 3 is green.
It should result in a different outcome depending on when you press the key and which color the cursor lands on...
The Context is, Tactical RPG in "attack" mode Red = Miss, Yellow = Normal Damage, Green = Critical, in "defense" mode, Red results in the enemy critting on you, yellow is normal damage and green would be you evading the attack... There would be different types of bars with varying color lengths... depending on wether it's attack mode (if it's an actor skill) or defense mode if it's an enemy skill being used...
Eventing a QTE: Time Hits Minigame | The Official RPG Maker Blog
Quick Time Events (QTEs) can add an extra bit of interaction between our players and our games, rewarding them for their focus. So let’s take a look at how we can event one type of QTEs: timed hits.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
I'll send you a QTE eventing tutorial as a base reference first, can you help me with this? We'll use the link as a starting point, but expand it to suit my basic needs.
I am obviously doing something wrong, as the cursor is not moving smoothly, it's flickering and jumping all over the place and I don't understand why...
Any help is appreciated... How do I make sure I can streamline this so I can easily program each bar's colors to be timed perfectly without much hassle?
